from collections import Counter
def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    counts=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg=counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    colors=[c for c,n in counts.items() if c!=bg and c!=4 and n>=8]
    boxes={}
    for c in colors:
        pts=[(r,k) for r in range(h) for k in range(w) if grid[r][k]==c]
        boxes[c]=(min(r for r,k in pts),max(r for r,k in pts),min(k for r,k in pts),max(k for r,k in pts))
    for r in range(h):
        for k in range(w):
            if grid[r][k]==bg: continue
            matches=[c for c,(r0,r1,k0,k1) in boxes.items() if r0<=r<=r1 and k0<=k<=k1]
            out[r][k]=matches[0] if matches else bg
    return out
